pages.text: Fletcher's Trestle replaces the vanilla bow with a $(l)modular$() one you build yourself. Every part: the limbs, riser, string, and each arrow's head, shaft, and fletching: is a real choice that changes how your weapon performs.$(br2)It all starts with a single tool: the $(item)Drawknife$().
The $(item)Drawknife$() is used at the $(l)Shaving Horse$() to strip logs into limbs. Craft one to begin the pipeline.

From here the woodworking pipeline flows: $(br)$(li)Shave logs into rough limbs$(li)Steam them pliable in the Steam Box$(li)Assemble and tune at the Fletching Table$(br2)Each following chapter covers a station in depth.
